Time-locked staking locks 150 units per identity for 20 epochs, 5% per honest epoch; locked funds cannot be recycled, immobilizing forgery capital.

A quill-bound credential binds each stake to one identity, so copying confers no advantage: the lock stays with the deposit, resetting on forgery.

Across a tundra of idle clones, 1,000 identities lock 150,000 units; a 30% forgery rate forfeits 60%, about 27,000 units, the onyx record adds 10 epochs.
